premise: Bear cub cannot fall asleep, so Owl shows him how: blink, look around, fluff up, yawn. Bear cub copies every step.
inspiration: The folk bedtime ritual, where each step of settling down is named in turn; turned so the helper shows instead of tells, and the child listening can copy too.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Cannot Sleep
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7 55s} {sfx:night-bed} [softly] The moon was up, and everyone was asleep. Everyone except the {bear:enter} bear cub. {bear:pulse} He wriggled and he {bear:wobble x2} wiggled. {bear:face sad} [sad] I can't fall asleep, he said. I don't know how. {owl:enter} Owl {owl:pulse} was wide awake, as owls are at night. {owl:face happy} [whispers] I'll show you, said Owl. Watch. {owl:live} He blinked, slowly. He looked around. He fluffed up his feathers. He gave a great big yawn… and closed his eyes. {bear:face normal} [curious] Now you try, he whispered. A {firefly:enter} firefly {firefly:glow} made a soft little light, just enough to see by. {bear:live} So the bear cub yawned, and stretched his arms up high. He rubbed his eyes. He patted his round tummy… and nodded off. {bear:face sleeping} {owl:face happy} [whispers] Goodnight, bear cub, said Owl. And the firefly {firefly:fade-out hold} turned her little light down low.

es-ES.title: El osito no se puede dormir
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7 55s} {sfx:night-bed} [softly] La luna ya había salido y todos dormían. Todos menos el {bear:enter} osito. {bear:pulse} Daba vueltas y {bear:wobble x2} más vueltas. {bear:face sad} [sad] No me puedo dormir, dijo. No sé cómo se hace. {owl:enter} Búho {owl:pulse} estaba bien despierto, como los búhos por la noche. {owl:face happy} [whispers] Yo te enseño, dijo Búho. Mira. {owl:live} Parpadeó despacio. Miró a su alrededor. Se ahuecó las plumas. Dio un bostezo enorme… y cerró los ojos. {bear:face normal} [curious] Ahora tú, susurró. Una {firefly:enter} luciérnaga {firefly:glow} encendió una lucecita suave, justo la necesaria para ver. {bear:live} Y el osito bostezó, y estiró los brazos bien alto. Se frotó los ojos. Se dio unas palmaditas en la barriga redonda… y se quedó dormido. {bear:face sleeping} {owl:face happy} [whispers] Buenas noches, osito, dijo Búho. Y la luciérnaga {firefly:fade-out hold} bajó su lucecita.

night-bed.prompt: a calm summer night in the woods, soft distant crickets and a light breeze
